digest.component_or_area: route reconciler mapper entrypoints through backend port
propositions: Reconciler core modules (outbound_differ, inbound_differ, apply_inbound) must not import vendor MAPPER entrypoints directly; they receive mapper implementations via Backend-port dependency injection
outbound_differ and inbound_differ use injected mappers to call map_local_to_remote() and map_remote_to_local() respectively instead of calling direct vendor functions
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK is relocated to adapters/jira/jira_fields.py as single source of truth for vendor link mapping
run_differs orchestrates mapper injection by resolving the configured Backend once and threading backend.outbound and backend.inbound into both differ phases with sensible defaults
Non-mapping vendor helpers (outbound_fields diffing/extraction functions, inbound value maps, reconcile_check lazy loader) remain directly imported as documented residual boundary
